content: Uwena Mawa

Sapadhana bhari-bharia apasiapuakea, KAWASANA OPU afirimanimo i Nuh, "Kompamo ingkoo tee saangua antona bhanuamu i nuncana bhangka maoge, roonamo ingkoomo ikamataku atotuu i aroaku i tanga-tangana manga mia i zamani incia sii.
Minaaka i bhari-bharia binata mohalala aalamo pitu pasa, umane tee bhawine, sainamo minaaka i binata moharamu sapasa, o umane tee bhawine.
Alamo uka minaaka i manu-manu i antara pitu pasa, umane tee bhawine, mamudhaakana siwuluna manga sadhaadhaana adhadhi i bhari-bharia bhawona alamu.
Roonamo pitu eopo uka Iaku bhekupasapo wao i bhawona alamu 40 eo 40 malo kangengena tee sagala mahaluku padha ipamembaliku sumai bhekuhapusuakea minaaka i bhawona alamu.
Kasiimpomo Nuh akarajaamo sagala iparintangiakana KAWASANA OPU i karona.
Nuh akoʼumurumo nama atu tao wakutuuna uwena mawa aumba atipua alamu,
tee to apasalaamatiaka karona minaaka i uwena mawa, Nuh apobhawa tee manga anana umane, bhawinena, tee manga ana maniana bhawine akompamo i nuncana bhangka maoge sumai.
Minaaka i manga binata mohalalana tee moharamu, manu-manu, tee sagala mopondelena i alamu,
sapasa-sapasa, umane tee bhawine, aumbamo i Nuh i nuncana bhangka maoge, mboomo iparintangiakana Aulataʼala i Nuh.
Sapadhana pitu eo, aumbamo uwena mawa atipua alamu.
Wakutuuna Nuh akoʼumuru 600 tao, i bula rua mbulana, eo sapulu pitu eona, apidhimo bhari-bharia matana uwe i nuncana tana, tee manga bhambana uwe i laiana uka atobungkale.
Wao maranca asapo i bhawona alamu 40 eo 40 malo kangengena.
I eo incia sumai uka Nuh, tee Sem, Ham, tee Yafet, sumaimo manga anana Nuh, bhawinena tee talu mia ana maniana bhawine apesua i nuncana bhangka maoge sumai.
Manga incia aose-osea sagala giu binata maila, sagala giu kadhambaaka, sagala giu binata mopondelena i alamu, tee sagala giu manu-manu, siitumo haewani mokopanina.
Bhari-bharia aumba i Nuh i nuncana bhangka maoge sumai, sapasa-sapasa minaaka i sagala mahaluku modhadhi tee mokoinyawana.
Bhari-bharia moumbana tee mopesuana siitumo o umane tee bhawine minaaka i sagala mahaluku, mboomo iparintangiakana Aulataʼala i Nuh. Kasiimpomo KAWASANA OPU atutubhia bhambana sumai i talikuna Nuh.
40 eo kangengena uwena mawa sumai atipua alamu. O uwe sumai torotorosu apene arangani kabharina saanampuu aangkamo bhangka maoge sumai alanto amalanga minaaka i bhawona alamu.
Wakutuuna o uwe ahanda kalangana tee kabharina i bhawona alamu, bhangka maoge sumai akalanto-lanto i bhawona uwe.
Tee uwe ahanda amakaa mpuu arangani atipua i bhawona alamu, sabutuna bhari-bharia gunu malanga modhaangiana i saangua kapeona laiana atotutubhi.
Uwe sumai torotorosu ahanda o kalangana sakawana atutubhi manga gunu momalanga. Uwena mawa ahanda kalangana pitu metere i bhawona lolona manga gunu sumai.

Kasiimpomo abinasamo bhari-bharia mahaluku mokomingkuna i alamu, manu-manu, kadhambaaka, binata maila, tee sagala binata mopondelena, sagala binata maidhiidhina mokaketu-ketuna i alamu, tee bhari-bharia maanusia.
Bhari-bharia modhaangiana i tana, tee bhari-bharia mopoinuncana tee ngalu i nuncana angona, amate.

Mboo sumaimo Aulataʼala ahapusu sagala mahaluku modhadhi, modhaangiana i bhawona alamu, amalape o maanusia, kadhadhi, tee binata mopondelena tee manu-manu i antara, bhari-bharia ahapusua minaaka i bhawona alamu. Tangkanamo Nuh modhadhina tee bhari-bharia mopobhawana tee incia i nuncana bhangka maoge sumai.
O uwena mawa sumai apatondu alamu 150 eo kangengena.
